propositions: During execution-phase plan re-review, Pass-1 finders flag plan-vs-code discrepancies that are expected results of completed directed work (e.g., plan directs 'remove X' and removal is done), blocking correct ticket closure as false positives.

A new na-default binary sub-answer `current_state_satisfies_plan_goal` set by the verifier via present-state code check enables Pass-2 veto to drop findings only when execution_review=True AND answer=yes.

The veto is cohort-restricted to registry.CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) with deterministic enforcement in orchestrator._restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded, preventing tool-less single-turn verification from firing the veto.
Planning-phase reviews remain unaffected; the execution_review flag defaults False so planning reviews and code-review calls are byte-unchanged.
Answers other than definite yes (no, insufficient, na, absent) do not trigger the veto under execution_review=True.
The new field is plan-review-model-only, defaults na, is excluded from GRADED_BINARY, and is absent from base and code-review models.
